question: The theme for International Mother Earth Day, 2021 was ‘________’.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Restore our Earth**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The theme for International Mother Earth Day, 2021** was **'Restore our Earth'.**
 
• Every year on** April 22nd,** the world celebrates Earth Day, also known as **International Mother Earth Day.**
 
• **The Earth Day 2022 Theme is Invest In Our Planet.**
 
• The day will be commemorated around the world to raise awareness about the environment and encourage people to support environmental protection.
 
• **The 51st anniversary **of World Earth Day, which began in 1970, celebrated in 2021.
 
• In 2009, the United Nations renamed Earth Day International Mother Earth Day.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Earth Day** was established in** 1970 **when around 20 million Americans felt that maintaining Mother Earth was a critical need.
 
• As a result, Earth Day was observed for the first time this year.
 
• Every year, billions of people throughout the world participate in various activities such as tree planting, cleanliness campaigns, and other activities to help Mother Nature.
